title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
Prerequisites

Several business partners must be assigned to the contract account.

Procedure

You can use the OtherPartner function to switch between the data of individual partners in the contract account.

1. On the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |}#Master Data » Contract Account > Display 3 (CAA3).
Enter the required contract account.
2. Then choose |Goto § Other Partner
3. The system displays a selection window for the business partners already assigned to the contract account.

4. Choose a business partner.

The data for this business partner is displayed and can be processed.

Selecting Addresses for Business Partners

Prerequisites

You have defined multiple addresses for a business partner want to use each of these addresses for a specific purpose (for
example, for dunning notices).

Procedure

1. In the Create Contract Account / Change Contract Account (CAA1/CAAZ2) transactions, on the General Data , Payments
/ Taxes, or Dunning / Correspondence tab pages, call the input help for the Address Description field.

A selection window appears with the business partner addresses maintained in the master record.

2. Choose the required address, for example, that you want to send a dunning notice to, by double-clicking it.

Result

The selected address is transferred. In the contract account master record, the Fixed indicator next to the address field is now
selected. It indicates that a specific address was selected and not the standard address of the business partner.

1 Note

You can use this function to select the address for each business partner in the contract account, regardless of whether this is
the owner of the contract account to be created or changed, or an alternative business partner (Such as the dunning recipient).

If you do not select an address, the default address of the contract account holder is used automatically for all business
transactions.
